metrics.note: Read-only query complete; native data, register and verification unchanged.

limits: Accepted-data inventory only. Native counts are top-level records; embedded actor/context items and presentation geometry are not counted. Calculation definitions overlap their native Measure owners; table categories are not one additive total.

Model scope and requirement-register scope are independent. Requirement subsets are exact IDs with no automatic descendant expansion; links crossing a requirement subset are reported separately, not included as internal traces.

Active/detached means the existing trace endpoint projection only. Declared lifecycle counts are not current verification, fulfillment, evidence adequacy or engineering acceptance. No calculations or verification run.

Legacy documents without an extension remain unchanged: native counts are available, typed metrics are unavailable (null), and existing legacy trace projection rules remain unchanged. Typed counts cover declared schema families and accepted literal entries; profiles/applications/opaque namespace contents, raw drafts and UI occurrences are not inventoried. Unsupported/malformed source refuses rather than substituting zero.
No provided register means trace metrics unavailable, distinct from an explicitly provided empty register. Source-stamped JSON export is documentary; it cannot execute or authorize verification.

limitations: Filters affect native record cards only; typed port/connector rendering, manual visibility and the complete model/ledger retain their existing scope. No normative SysML Viewpoint/Concern or engineering approval is inferred.
